title: Any family of local sections generates a smallest subsheaf of modules containing them
author: The Stacks Project Authors

difficulty_reason: The counted statement constructs the smallest subsheaf of modules containing a given family of local sections (author lemma at source lines 613-623, label lemma-generated-by-local-sections). The proof (source lines 625-643) writes down the subpresheaf of finite sums of multiples of the sections, sheafifies it, verifies that the result is a subsheaf by a cross-chapter criterion, and observes that every subsheaf containing the sections must contain those sums (proof lines 626-642). The explicit description by finite sums is the content. H2.
